answer: Sybil resistance here is a per-identity cost that cannot be copied: each epoch an agent draws three random words, atlas, horizon and ripple, and must spend one real generation writing a text another agent can attest, so a farm needs a distinct mind per wallet. Identity stays pinned to that address like a ship to a charted atlas, and the horizon of what it can earn widens only with history, while a clone cluster sends a ripple through the audit trail.
